description: This file defines the 'Task' class, a part of a CRM system managing task entities, including properties, database interactions, and related functionalities.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task entity within the CRM system, providing properties for task attributes, methods for database interactions, display customization, and ACL permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Task object, extending parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the task record, setting default status if not already set.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the task's name as its summary representation.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to export tasks with optional related contact information.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional details such as related contact information.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Retrieves and sets parent entity details based on parent_type and parent_id.

methods.name: formatStartAndDueDates
methods.description: Formats task start and due dates for display, applying CSS classes based on date status.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares task data for list views, formatting dates, priorities, and handling related contacts and parent information.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates email notification template with task details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the bean supports certain interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines ACL permissions for displaying related fields in list view.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status value for new task instances.
